summary: Dry, mostly cloudy morning turning sunnier, with a cold start (about 0–1 °C at Medinaceli and Daroca) and possible frost or fog patches; no AEMET warnings found. Medinaceli figures are from AEMET's daily table; the hourly Medinaceli page was stale and discarded.
sunset: High cloud and sunny spells over Madrid in the afternoon; the evening is beyond the hourly forecast found.

verdict.text: Near 0 °C at dawn on the A-2 at Medinaceli (about 1 °C, humidity near 100%) and at Daroca (0–3 °C), so frost or fog patches are possible on the morning drive; dry with light wind, 7–14 °C later. Drive gently on bridges and shaded stretches before 10:00.
